_comment: Второй проход: кадры, которые агенты после первой полировки честно назвали неидеальными. Сцены переписаны так, чтобы убрать конкретную причину провала (мелкота, бледность, неоднозначность силуэта). Генерировать строго по scene.

items.problem: рукав читался как палка/кокон, плечо — как кулак
items.scene: a whole long-sleeved shirt seen from the front, the right sleeve stretched out to the side with a clear cuff and two buttons at the end

items.problem: вышла буква V из двух досок
items.scene: a round character standing at a table with one arm bent and the elbow resting on the tabletop, the other hand on its hip

items.problem: слишком бледно, на 40 px размывается
items.scene: a wide empty room with a large window casting a strong terracotta sunlight patch on the wooden floor, one small chair standing far away in the corner

items.problem: настил занял полкадра, лодки спрятались под ним
items.scene: two small boats tied by ropes to one short wooden pier post standing in blue water, no large deck

items.problem: выцвело, табличка — тонкая палка
items.scene: a station platform edge with a thick yellow safety line along it, one bench and a round blue station sign on a post, drawn large in frame

items.problem: в углу остался водяной знак генератора
items.scene: two dogs standing side by side facing the viewer, one short and round with floppy ears, one tall and slim with a long snout, both large and centered

items.problem: яйцо распалось на два белых кома
items.scene: a frying pan seen from above with one fried egg inside, a round yellow yolk in the middle of a white, and a long handle

items.problem: кувшин читался как колба
items.scene: a measuring jug with a handle and a pouring spout, half filled with blue water, standing on a table

items.problem: бумага кремовая на белом, контраст почти нулевой
items.scene: a white sheet of paper with a large gold star sticker in the corner, the paper outlined by a thick terracotta border so it reads on white

items.problem: бледная сетка на белом, не видно на 40 px
items.scene: a wall planner with a thick dark teal grid of blank squares, a pencil hanging on a string beside it

items.problem: не было стола, пазл выцвел
items.scene: three round characters each holding one large puzzle piece and joining them together in the middle, seen from above

items.problem: поезд крошечный, на 40 px исчезает
items.scene: a round character standing on a platform waiting while a train arrives close by on the track, the train large and clearly visible

items.problem: по краям остались чужие кремовые пятна
items.scene: five round white ice stones falling from one small dark cloud toward the ground, short motion lines behind each stone, clean empty background

items.problem: вода как лужа, стул не плавает
items.scene: water risen up to a house door with a small wooden boat floating on the surface in front of the door

items.problem: солнце и персонаж читались как два отдельных объекта
items.scene: a round character with both arms wide open raised toward one big round sun, arms thick and connected to the body, one single gesture

items.problem: бледная балка весов
items.scene: a balance scale with a thick dark teal beam, three coins on one pan and a folded paper on the other, the beam clearly tilted

items.problem: медаль читалась как обруч
items.scene: a round character standing with hands on its hips and one large five-pointed gold star badge pinned on its chest

items.problem: тонкий ободок работал как запрещённый контур
items.scene: a round character with both hands up beside its head and its mouth open in a small O, three short burst lines above

items.problem: олень с огромными ушами читался как лиса
items.scene: a fox, a rabbit and a bird standing together in a grassy clearing, the fox with a pointed snout and a bushy tail

items.problem: фигуры мелкие и бледные
items.scene: three round characters standing large in frame singing with open mouths, one music note floating above them

items.problem: не было полосатых футболок, фигуры однотонные
items.scene: five round characters in matching striped teal shirts standing in one row with arms linked

items.problem: не было флаговых столбов
items.scene: a round character with a suitcase stepping over a thick striped border line painted on the ground, two tall flag poles standing on either side

items.problem: шестерёнка в блоке не отрисовалась
items.scene: a flowchart of three rounded boxes connected by thick arrows, the middle box containing a large gear wheel
